info.title: Argon Bot API
info.description: HTTP API for Argon bots. Every request carries a bot token as `Authorization: Bot <token>`; the token may also be given as the first path segment. Interfaces are versioned independently, so `/IMessages/v1/Send` and `/IMessages/v2/Send` can both exist.

tags.name: IArchetypes
tags.description: List and inspect archetypes (roles) in a space. Permissions are hidden unless the bot has ManageArchetype entitlement.

tags.name: IBotSelf
tags.description: Get information about the authenticated bot and its spaces.

tags.name: ICalls
tags.description: Receive and manage incoming calls. Verified bots only.

tags.name: IChannels
tags.description: Create, list, and delete channels within a space.

tags.name: ICommands
tags.description: Register, update, list, and delete slash commands for your bot.

tags.name: IEvents
tags.description: Subscribe to real-time events via Server-Sent Events (SSE). Receive messages, member changes, voice activity, and more.

tags.name: IInteractions
tags.description: Respond to slash-command, control, and select interactions. Supports ack, defer, modal, reply, and edit.

tags.name: IMembers
tags.description: Manage space members: kick users from channels.

tags.name: IMessages
tags.description: Send messages and retrieve message history from channels.

tags.name: IReactions
tags.description: Add and remove emoji reactions on messages.

tags.name: ISpaces
tags.description: Get space details and member information.

tags.name: ITyping
tags.description: Send typing indicators to channels. Typing status automatically expires after 8 seconds.

tags.name: IVoice
tags.description: Get voice streaming tokens for audio ingress. Bots stream Opus audio directly to a WebSocket endpoint — no WebRTC needed.

tags.name: IVoiceEgress
tags.description: Subscribe to individual voice tracks for audio egress. Verified bots only.
